Know what’s included—and what’s extra.

Mow Matter platform fees on collected customer payments: Solo Starter 3.5% · Growth Route 2.5% · Scale & Crew 1.5%, plus Stripe processing fees. On a $100 customer payment, the platform fee is $3.50, $2.50 or $1.50 respectively. Homeowners pay their lawn company; the operator handles service refunds and disputes. Payment collection is pending Stripe Connect activation.

Credits apply to eligible AI tasks such as route re-optimization. Instant Quotes has its own add-on allowance. Credit costs per action, add-on packs, expiration and communication allowances will be published before billing launches. No paid checkout is active on this page.
